_comment: Path patterns that decide when a tech-mappings domain is being touched. Consulted only by first_touch_of_domain, the Tier 2 trigger. JSON rather than Markdown for the same reason as checks.json: build_graph.py globs ROOT/**/*.md and would turn a .md here into a graph node. There are eight files in tech-mappings/ and one entry here, on purpose -- a domain is added the session a check names it, not in advance. Patterns are searched against the path relative to the repo the edit happened in, so they match a file's role rather than anyone's home directory.

security-hardening._comment: Deliberately does not match .env, secrets.yaml or any file expected to hold live credentials. Matching those would mean the engine reacts to the moment a secret is on screen, and every reaction it can make is written to a plain log.
